intro.title: One contract. One team. Full ownership of the result.
intro.text: Most projects in Greece fail at the seams — between the architect and the builder, the builder and the permit office, the owner abroad and the site at home. Modera removes the seams. We plan, permit, engineer, build and hand over under a single management structure, so you always know who is responsible, what it costs and when it will be finished.
points: Personal service from feasibility to handover
Fixed scopes, transparent budgets, weekly reporting
In-house engineering, permits and site management
Bilingual project leads for international owners

services.title: Five disciplines. One delivery model.
services.lead: Engage us for a single discipline or the complete journey. Either way, you get senior people and a process built for certainty.

sectors.title: From a family home to a resort.
sectors.lead: Four sectors, one standard of craft. Our teams move between them because the fundamentals — structure, regulation, cost and time — never change.

process.title: A process designed to remove surprises.
process.lead: Every Modera project follows the same five-stage path, with a clear decision gate at the end of each stage.

steps.title: Feasibility & due diligence
steps.text: Plot and title checks, zoning and building coefficients, archaeological and forestry status, utilities, access — and an honest view on budget and timeline before you commit.

steps.title: Design & engineering
steps.text: Architecture, structural, mechanical and electrical design developed together, priced as we go, and optimised for the Cretan climate and seismic code.

steps.title: Permits & approvals
steps.text: We prepare and submit the full building-permit file and manage every authority involved — from the municipality and the Ephorate of Antiquities to energy and tourism licensing.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Our own site managers run the works with vetted trades, a live programme and weekly photo reports. Quality is inspected at every hold point, not at the end.

steps.title: Handover & aftercare
steps.text: Commissioning, as-built documentation, energy certificate, warranties and a 12-month aftercare period. We stay reachable long after the keys change hands.

film.title: Craft you can see. Control you can measure.
film.text: From excavation to the last coat of lime plaster, our site managers are on the ground every working day. Owners abroad follow progress through weekly reports, photos and video walk-throughs.

insights.title: Knowledge from the site, not the brochure.

faq.a: Yes. We are based in Chania and work across Crete — Chania, Rethymno, Heraklion and Lasithi — and take on selected projects elsewhere in Greece, particularly in hospitality and infrastructure.

faq.q: Can you manage a project while I live abroad?
faq.a: That is how most of our international clients work with us. You receive weekly written reports, photos and video walk-throughs, and you can approve decisions remotely. Site visits are arranged around your trips.

faq.q: Do you only build, or also design and handle permits?
faq.a: Both. You can appoint us for the complete design-build journey, or for a single discipline such as engineering management, contractor oversight or the permit process.

faq.q: How do you price a project?
faq.a: After feasibility we prepare a cost plan tied to the design. As the design develops we refine it into a detailed bill of quantities, so the final contract price reflects a fully defined scope.

faq.q: Which languages do you work in?
faq.a: Our team works in Greek, English and Hebrew, and our documentation can be prepared for owners in French, German, Russian, Spanish and Dutch.

cta.title: Have a plot, a building or an idea?
cta.text: Tell us about it. A senior member of our team will reply within one business day with next steps — no obligation.

hero.title: Everything a project needs, under one roof.
hero.lead: Five integrated disciplines that can be engaged together or individually. The common thread: senior people, a documented process and full accountability.

items.title: Construction
items.short: General contracting for new builds, extensions and renovations — delivered by our own site managers.
items.text: We act as general contractor, coordinating every trade from earthworks and reinforced concrete to stonework, joinery, MEP and landscaping. Our site managers are on site daily, working to a live programme and a written quality plan with inspections at every critical hold point.
bullets: New-build villas, residences and apartment buildings
Renovation and restoration of stone buildings
Structural, MEP, finishes and external works

items.title: Development
items.short: From land to a finished, income-ready asset — feasibility, design, delivery and positioning.
items.text: For landowners and investors we take projects from an idea to a completed, marketable asset. We test feasibility, define the right product for the location, manage design and approvals and deliver the build, with returns and exit in mind from day one.
bullets: Product definition for residential and hospitality

items.title: Contractor oversight
items.short: Owner’s representation when another contractor builds — protecting quality, cost and time.
items.text: If you already have a builder, we sit on your side of the table. We review contracts and bills of quantities, certify progress payments, inspect quality and track the programme, so that what you pay for is what gets built.

items.title: Engineering management
items.short: Structural, mechanical and electrical engineering coordinated by one technical lead.
items.text: Our engineering team coordinates architecture, structural, mechanical and electrical design, aligned to the Greek seismic and energy regulations. We manage design development, value engineering and site supervision so that design intent survives contact with the site.
bullets: Value engineering without loss of quality
Energy performance in line with KENAK and NZEB

items.title: Permits & regulatory affairs
items.short: Building permits and approvals managed end-to-end with the municipality and every competent authority.
items.text: Greek permitting involves many authorities: the municipal building office, the Ephorate of Antiquities, forestry and coastal services, utilities and — for hotels — tourism licensing. Our regulatory team prepares the files, tracks every step and resolves questions before they become delays.

Environmental and Natura 2000 approvals where required

hero.title: Four sectors. One standard.
hero.lead: We build homes, places of work, places to stay — and the infrastructure that makes them possible.

items.title: Residential
items.short: Private villas, family homes and apartment buildings.
items.text: From a sea-view villa in Apokoronas to a multi-unit residence in the city, we combine contemporary design with Cretan materials and the discipline of a structured process. Owners abroad receive the same visibility as if they were on site.

items.title: Commercial
items.text: Commercial buildings must work hard — for tenants, operators and investors. We plan for flexibility, efficient services and durable materials, and phase works to protect existing operations when we extend or refit.

items.title: Hospitality & tourism
items.short: Boutique hotels, resorts and rental villa complexes.
items.text: Tourism is Crete’s engine, and hospitality buildings are among the most demanding to deliver: seasonal deadlines, operator standards and licensing. We build to open on time — from boutique hotels and suites to large resort projects.

items.title: Infrastructure
items.short: Roads, utilities, earthworks and site development.
items.text: Every great building depends on what lies beneath and around it. We deliver earthworks, access roads, retaining structures, water, drainage, power and telecom networks — for our own projects and for private and public clients.

hero.title: Rooted in Chania. Built on accountability.
hero.lead: For more than a decade, Modera Group has been building homes, hotels, commercial buildings and infrastructure across Crete — with one simple promise: we own the result.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Modera Group was founded by people who had seen too many good projects go wrong for avoidable reasons: unclear responsibilities, permits that stalled for months, budgets that drifted and owners abroad who learned about problems too late.

So we built the company around the opposite idea. Design, engineering, permits and construction are managed by one team, under one contract, with one person accountable for your project. That model has carried us through more than 60 projects — from private villas to hospitality and infrastructure works.

Today we combine Cretan craftsmanship with the reporting, cost control and governance expected by international investors — supported by our strategic partners, Sivan Invest Group and the Harmony Fund.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: Modera Group (“we”) is the controller of personal data submitted through this website. We process the details you provide in our contact form — name, email, phone, country and project information — solely to respond to your enquiry and, where you ask us to, to prepare a proposal.

The legal basis is your consent and our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries (Article 6(1)(a) and (f) GDPR). Form submissions are transmitted through a secure form-handling service and delivered to our mailbox.
We keep enquiry data for up to 24 months unless a contract follows, in which case statutory retention periods apply. We do not sell personal data or use it for automated decision-making.

You may request access, correction, deletion or restriction of your data, or object to its processing, by writing to support@modera-group.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).
This website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Embedded maps are loaded only when you scroll to them.
